name: pi-research-fresh
description: `/research` runs a tool-using deep-research workflow on the active Pi session model. Start it and walk away: the target is a substantial, cited Markdown report in about ten minutes. It writes a brief, searches and reads sources, follows gaps, ranks passages, and writes the report without asking for approval. The assistant draft is visible in Pi; the saved Markdown resolves its passage IDs into linked citations.

scripts.test: tsx test/research-loop.test.ts && tsx test/research-evidence.test.ts && tsx test/research-corpus.test.ts && tsx test/source-credibility.test.ts && tsx test/porter.test.ts
